entities.summary: The Royal and Pontifical University of Mexico was a university founded on 21 September 1551 by Royal Decree signed by Charles I of Spain, in Valladolid, Spain. It is generally considered one of the first universities founded in North America and second in the Americas (preceded by the National University of San Marcos in Lima, Peru, chartered on May 12 of the same year, and the Universidad Michoacana de San Nicolás de Hidalgo, formerly known as the Royal College of Saint Nicholas, established in 1540. After the Mexican War of Independence it was renamed the University of Mexico.
